scope: Independent falsification of newest complete eligible T0 work under downstream backpressure. No fresh names opened. TER and SERV challenged against exact live gates; prior Beta evidence reused only after preserving independent challenge.
summary: No new 1800Z contradiction falsifies either thesis. TER's legacy convertible/warrant complex remains extinguished and must not be inflated into current dilution; the live defect is 2026 SBC/current-debt/repurchase normalization. The valid present challenge is current 2026 SBC/current debt/repurchase behavior plus customer and AI-capex concentration.
risks: Current SBC may dilute owners even though legacy convertibles are extinguished.
Customer and AI-capex concentration can make earnings more fragile than segment breadth implies.
Repurchases may mask SBC or destroy value if poorly timed.
contradictions: Legacy convertible/warrant risk as current exposure is contradicted by primary filings showing maturity/expiry.
unknowns: 2026 SBC/unvested awards, fully diluted share count, current debt and executed repurchases.
evidence.exactGate: Current 2026 SBC/governance dilution, current debt and executed repurchases are not yet normalized reproducibly; historical convertibles/warrants must be excluded.
evidence.nextLawfulSourcePath: Teradyne 2026 definitive proxy equity-compensation tables plus latest 2026 Form 10-Q debt/equity/share-count and repurchase disclosures.

claims: Serve's June 30, 2026 cash balance is a point-in-time liquidity fact, not a runway conclusion.

The strongest present falsification path remains financing/runway and concentration, not speculative denial of the sidewalk-autonomy market.
risks: Cash fell from $106.239M at 2025 year-end to $79.112M at June 30, 2026; runway cannot be inferred without H1 operating cash use.
ATM, warrants and SBC may transfer meaningful upside away from current owners.

contradictions: Any treatment of Q2 cash alone as proof of adequate runway exceeds the evidence.
